text: This music feels like a midnight journey through an ancient city. I can almost imagine the warm lights, quiet streets, distant conversations, and the sound of music coming from a small hidden café. Maybe that’s why I keep coming back to it. My real life has been anything but peaceful lately. I’ve been dealing with work pressure, financial stress, and the constant responsibility of trying to make everything work. Sometimes I miss the person I was before I started worrying about everything. Music like this reminds me that there is still a softer part of me underneath all that stress. For a few minutes, I don’t have to be productive or responsible. I can simply exist. To everyone reading this, I hope you find a place, a song, or a moment that makes you feel alive again. May your restless heart find its way back to peace. 🌙🎷❤
